title: Sand Dollar on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Just steps from the glittering Gulf, this beautifully updated four-bedroom vacation home in historic Grayton Beach offers space for up to 12 guests and blends classic coastal charm with fresh, modern upgrades. Its location is truly exceptional — a quick three-minute stroll
description_expanded: Just steps from the glittering Gulf, this beautifully updated four-bedroom vacation home in historic Grayton Beach offers space for up to 12 guests and blends classic coastal charm with fresh, modern upgrades. Its location is truly exceptional — a quick three-minute stroll leads you down a sandy path beside the protected dunes of Grayton Beach State Park , where the shoreline stretches wide and uncrowded, perfect for beach games, sunbathing, or long barefoot walks. Or head to the nearby Western Lake access , where the rare coastal dune lake often merges seamlessly with the Gulf — a vibrant, ever-changing spot where locals gather, families play, and colorful beach vehicles add to the uniquely laid-back energy of Grayton. Surrounded on two sides by preserved parkland and just minutes from the lake’s outfall, this is 30A at its most iconic and unspoiled. Step inside Sand Dollar to an open, light-filled living space where fresh interior paint and all-new LED lighting create a bright, welcoming atmosphere. New furnishings and coastal-inspired accents bring a relaxed sophistication, while a wall of windows and glass doors frames the view of your private pool below. A spacious balcony stretches the full width of the home, inviting you to linger with a morning coffee or evening cocktail as the breeze rolls in. Just beyond, the kitchen is well-appointed for casual meals and beach snacks, featuring stainless steel appliances, a 6-burner gas range with oven, a sleek side-by-side refrigerator, ample pantry space, and a breakfast bar that keeps everyone connected while meals come together. Outside, your lagoon‑shaped pool beckons with plenty of patio loungers, a porch swing, and a covered dining terrace ideal for alfresco meals and cool refreshments. A grill and convenient outdoor shower make poolside living effortless, and a charming half bath on the first floor adds ease and comfort to your days. Sleeping quarters on the second floor include three inviting guest rooms: a king bedroom with its own private en-suite bath featuring a walk-in shower, a queen room, and a third with two full beds that share a hall bath with a tub/shower combination. Upstairs, the spacious Primary Suite spans the top level with a king bed, cozy sitting area with a queen sleeper sofa, and a private balcony that catches the Gulf breeze. The en-suite bath offers a relaxing retreat with dual vanities, a large walk-in shower, and a soaking garden tub. A dedicated laundry area on this floor adds everyday convenience for longer stays. Just beyond your doorstep, the heart of Grayton Beach awaits — a laid-back, walkable village full of character and coastal charm. Grab your morning coffee at Hotz Coffee, conveniently connected to Chiringo , an open-air beach bar serving up cold drinks and fresh, flavorful grubs just steps from the sand. The iconic Red Bar , known around the world for its eclectic atmosphere, exceptional food, and nightly live music, is an absolute must. Browse the curated racks at Tribe Kelley Surf Post, a stylish boutique with a boho-luxe vibe, or explore local galleries and artist studios tucked into this colorful community. When you're ready to roam, WaterColor and Seaside are just minutes away — two beloved 30A destinations offering even more dining, shopping, and family-friendly events, from open-air concerts to seasonal festivals under the stars. First Floor:  Covered Parking, Picnic Area, Half Bath. Second Floor:  Living Room with Screened Porch Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Full Beds. Third Floor:  King Primary Suite with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Walk-In Shower + Garden Tub, Balcony Access, Laundry.
